query:
UPDATE attempts a SET
            earned_points = v.e, max_points = v.m, percentage = v.p,
            submitted_at = CASE WHEN $5 THEN LEAST(now(), a.deadline) ELSE a.submitted_at END
         FROM unnest($1::uuid[], $2::int[], $3::int[], $4::float8[]) AS v(id, e, m, p)
         WHERE a.id = v.id
